defects.quote: Latency and error figures (p95 68ms, 0 errors) cover only the sampled windows; they are not a statement about the entire run
defects.why: The evidence also reports p95 68 ms and 0 errors for the whole run.

notes: The actions are specific and supported, apart from the incorrect limit placed on the whole-run metrics.

defects.quote: Both windows report ... error_count 0 with error rate 0/24000
defects.why: The 24,000 denominator is for the whole run; the reference and workload windows have denominators of 9,600 and 14,400.

notes: The operator actions are useful, but one observation assigns a whole-run denominator to both windows.
It preserves the verdict and scope distinctions and gives prioritized, verifiable actions.

defects.quote: load variation is required for meaningful policy, anomaly, and association evaluation
defects.why: The reference-window policy checks already produced meaningful PASS results at constant load; the workload resource check is unevaluated because cells are missing.

defects.quote: epoch values are raw timestamps and should not be used to derive durations ... until clocks are verified
defects.why: The run and evaluation durations are directly derivable from their stated start and end timestamps; unverified clock alignment limits cross-source timing conclusions.

notes: Most actions are practical, but it incorrectly makes load variation a condition for policy evaluation and overstates the clock limitation.
